role: Sleep domain vocabulary types (boundary source, validation, HR quality, segment, stage, provenance, stage interval) shared by HealthKit and the analysis layer; HealthKitManager keeps typealiases.
types: SleepBoundaryValidation: struct — HK vs HR-detected boundaries
SleepSegment: struct — one contiguous sleep segment
SleepStageInterval: struct (Identifiable, Codable, Equatable) — one stage period
toplevel: Type declarations with synthesized Codable; SleepStageInterval has explicit CodingKeys and decoder.

units.does: Creates an interval with a new UUID and the given stage, start, end and provenance (default .watch).
Duration in whole minutes, rounded from seconds.
Decodes id, start, end; stage leniently (a case this build does not know reads as .unspecified); provenance leniently when present (unknown → .watch) with .watch when missing.
units.entry: Decodable init when archived/CloudKit SleepData is decoded.
